articles.title: Apple shares rise 3% as first foldable iPhone d...
articles.description: Apple unveiled its first foldable iPhone, the Duo, priced at a record high, causing Apple shares to rise 3%. The launch shifts focus to average selling price growth rather than unit sales, with the Duo's unique hinge as a key feature. Skyworks Solutions, a major Apple supplier, rallied 9% due to expected higher content per device and merger news with Qorvo. Alphabet also saw a modest 2% gain amid broad tech sector strength. Investors will watch UK pre-orders in October to gauge demand and supplier impact.
